dash.title: Your projects
dash.subtitle: Describe an idea, create a React Native/Expo mobile app, preview, edit and publish — all on your machine.
dash.search: Search projects by name, description or path…
dash.empty_hint: Click “＋ New project” to create an app from the Todo, Education or blank template; or “Open folder…” to import an existing project.
dash.remove_note:
Only removes it from App Builder AI's list. The folder on disk is KEPT:
{path}
dash.import_no_package: The folder has no package.json — it may not be an Expo/React Native project. Import anyway?
dash.import_done: Imported. Imported projects are marked “untrusted” — you will be asked before the first install/run.
wiz.title: Create new project
wiz.s1.title: App information
wiz.s1.sub: Name, package identifiers and location. The package ID is hard to change after release.
wiz.s2.title: Category, template and style
wiz.s2.sub: Pick one or more categories. A starter template is suggested automatically; you can change it.
wiz.s3.title: Storage, backend and permissions
wiz.s3.sub: Defaults: local storage, no backend, no sensitive permissions.
wiz.s4.title: AI provider and budget
wiz.s4.sub: Saved to the project spec and used once AI is connected.
wiz.s5.title: Describe your app
wiz.s5.sub: Write in English or Vietnamese. Reference images/docs are copied into the project and never sent anywhere.
wiz.name: App name
wiz.desc_ph: What is the app for, and who uses it?
wiz.dest_exists: The target folder already exists and is not empty — change the app name or parent folder.
wiz.ios_note: Note: on Windows, iOS is previewed via web or Expo Go on a real iPhone; IPA builds need EAS cloud or a macOS machine (M7).
wiz.category_no_template: No dedicated template yet for: {cats}. The matching shell is used; the AI agent (M3) will add features from your description. More templates in M8.
wiz.cap_sensitive: Needs permission config, a privacy policy and separate testing
wiz.cap_note: These are recorded in the spec as requirements. Current templates do NOT add native permissions; when enabled, the AI agent (M3) will propose a config patch for your review.
wiz.model_ph: Pick from the provider's model list after connecting (M2)
wiz.mode.economy: Economy — minimal context, diffs instead of rewrites, max 1 auto-fix round
wiz.ai_notice: Provider connections (API keys in Windows Credential Manager), model lists and cost tracking arrive in M2. Creating an app from a template needs no AI and costs nothing.
wiz.prompt_ph: e.g. A family task notes app, pastel colors, bottom tab bar, morning reminders…
wiz.refs_note: PNG/JPG/TXT/MD up to 5 MB each. Only sent to an AI when you explicitly ask and confirm.
panel.asset_license: Source / license (e.g. own work, CC-BY 4.0 – author X):
panel.deps_not_installed: Dependencies not installed — click the button below (needs network, ~1–3 min).
panel.trash_failed: Could not move to the Recycle Bin.
panel.name: Name:
ws.diff_notice: Side-by-side diff of AI-proposed changes, Apply/Reject, checkpoints and undo.
ws.review_notice: Checklist for features, accessibility, TypeScript (tsc), tests, dependency warnings — with file/line and jump-to-code.
preview.title: Expo web live preview
preview.notice: Runs `npx expo start --web` on a dynamic port with a health check, shown in a phone frame (iPhone/Android, rotate, light/dark), with hot reload. No fake screenshots.
preview.webengine_missing: Qt WebEngine missing — preview will open in an external browser.
preview.manual:
Until M4 you can run it manually in a terminal:
  cd "{path}"
  npx expo start --web
assist.title: AI Assistant
assist.notice: Connect OpenAI / DeepSeek / Gemini / Claude in M2; planning, small patches, diff review and apply in M3. Ctrl+Enter to send.
assist.history_notice: Conversation history (stored only if enabled in Settings).
assist.prompt_ph: e.g. Make the home screen pastel, add a bottom tab bar, keep the login logic unchanged.
bottom.problems_notice: TypeScript/lint errors with file, line, severity and jump-to-code.
bottom.build_notice: Android APK/AAB (Gradle) and EAS build logs, with secrets redacted.
bottom.git_notice: git status, commits, checkpoints; private/public GitHub publish with secret scan.
bottom.usage_notice: Input/output tokens, estimated cost from a dated price table, 80% budget warnings.
editor.title: Code editor
editor.too_big: File larger than 2 MB — open it in an external editor.
editor.binary: Binary file — not opened in the editor.
editor.conflict: “{name}” was modified outside the IDE since you opened it. Overwriting will lose that change.
editor.changed_outside: ⚠ {name} changed outside while you were editing — you will be asked on save
doctor.title: Environment check (Doctor)
doctor.sub: Detects tools needed for preview, build and publish. Nothing is installed automatically. You can set paths in Settings.
settings.title: Settings
settings.keep_history: Keep AI conversation history (off by default)
settings.clear_confirm: Delete all conversation history and model cache? The project list is kept.
settings.no_telemetry: App Builder AI sends no telemetry. API keys are stored only in Windows Credential Manager.
settings.restart: Restart the application to apply the new language.
status.created: Project created from template. Next: Dependencies → Install dependencies.
trust.title: Trust this workspace?
trust.text: Installing/running “{name}” executes project and dependency code on your machine.
close.running: A process is still running. Stop it and quit?
